name: Katyayani Prozol Propiconazole 25% EC Systematic Fungicide
description: Systemic triazole fungicide with 25% EC propiconazole that moves upward in the plant and stops scab, rust and powdery mildew from spreading. Spray 1 ml per litre of water (200-250 ml per acre) at first sign of lesions and repeat after 12-15 days. Works on apple, grape, wheat, rice and groundnut.

name: Magic FungiX For Fungal disease
description: Plant-extract based broad spectrum fungicide for black rot, canker and fruit rot on orchard crops. Mix 2-3 ml per litre and drench both leaf surfaces plus the trunk collar, repeating every 10 days during wet weather. Safe for pollinators and leaves no residue, so it suits fruit close to harvest.

name: Katyayani All in 1 Organic Fungicide
description: Botanical multi-fungicide blended from neem, karanja and clove extracts for rust, scab and leaf spot complexes. Use 3 ml per litre of water as a preventive spray every 10-12 days from green-tip stage onward. Certified for organic apple and vegetable blocks and tank-mixable with most bio-stimulants.

name: Tapti Booster Organic Fertilizer
description: Seaweed and humic acid growth booster that keeps healthy apple trees in vigorous vegetative flush. Dilute 2-3 ml per litre and spray on foliage every 15 days, or apply 500 ml per acre through drip irrigation. Improves leaf shine, fruit set and stress tolerance without any chemical residue.

name: KrishiDisha Plant Health Starter Kit
description: Starter scouting kit with a 10x hand lens, leaf sampling pouches, a laminated symptom chart and a photo guide for taking clear leaf images for AI diagnosis. Use it when a scan returns no leaf in frame so you can recapture a sharp, well-lit picture. Handy for field scouts and FPO extension workers covering many plots.

name: GreenStix Fertilizer
description: Slow-release NPK 12-8-8 fertilizer sticks that feed acid-loving berry bushes for up to 60 days. Push two sticks into moist soil at the drip line of each blueberry plant and water lightly. Ideal for pot and terrace cultivation where regular fertigation is not practical.

name: ROM Mildew Clean
description: Sulphur and potassium bicarbonate based powder that dries out powdery mildew colonies on contact. Dissolve 2 g per litre of water and spray to run-off in the cool hours, repeating every 7-10 days while humidity stays high. Approved for organic cherry and grape orchards with a nil waiting period.

name: Plantic Organic BloomDrop Liquid Plant Food
description: Organic liquid plant food rich in potash and amino acids for flowering and fruit-setting stages. Mix 5 ml per litre of water and drench the root zone once a fortnight through bloom and fruit development. Keeps healthy cherry trees productive without pushing excess leafy growth.

name: ANTRACOL FUNGICIDE
description: Contact fungicide with 70% propineb WP that also supplies plant-available zinc, controlling cercospora and gray leaf spot. Spray 2.5 g per litre (600-700 g per acre) starting at first spotting and repeat at 10-day intervals. Widely used on maize, potato, tomato and grape.

name: 3 STAR M45 Mancozeb 75% WP Contact Fungicide
description: Multi-site contact fungicide with 75% mancozeb WP, the workhorse protectant against rust, blight and leaf spot. Use 2-2.5 g per litre of water (about 800 g per acre) as a preventive cover spray every 8-10 days. Low resistance risk, so it is the ideal tank-mix partner for systemic fungicides on maize and potato.

name: QUIT (Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP) Protective And Curative Fungicide
description: Premix of carbendazim 12% and mancozeb 63% WP giving both curative systemic and protective contact action on northern leaf blight. Spray 2 g per litre of water (500 g per acre) at disease onset and repeat once after 12 days. Also useful as a seed treatment at 2 g per kg of maize or wheat seed.

name: Biomass Lab Sampoorn Fasal Ahaar (Multipurpose Organic Fertilizer & Plant Food)
description: Multipurpose organic fertilizer and plant food made from decomposed biomass, humic substances and beneficial microbes. Broadcast 1 kg per 100 sq m or 8-10 kg per acre at sowing and again at the knee-high stage of maize. Builds soil organic carbon while keeping healthy crops evenly green.

name: Southern Ag Captan 50% WP Fungicide
description: Protectant fungicide with 50% captan WP for black rot, anthracnose and fruit rot of grapes and pome fruit. Mix 2 g per litre and spray thoroughly from shoot elongation until berries touch, at 10-14 day intervals. Best applied before rain-splash spreads the spores from mummified berries.

name: ALIETTE FUNGICIDE
description: Fosetyl-aluminium 80% WP, a true systemic that travels both up and down the plant against trunk and root diseases such as esca and downy mildew. Spray 2.5 g per litre or paint 5 g per litre onto pruning wounds and cankers. Two applications in the pre-monsoon window give season-long protection to grape vines.

name: Tebulur Tebuconazole 10% + Sulphur 65% WG , Advance Broad Spectrum Premix Fungicides
description: Advanced premix of tebuconazole 10% and sulphur 65% WG that handles isariopsis leaf spot plus powdery mildew in one pass. Dissolve 2 g per litre of water (500 g per acre) and spray at 12-15 day intervals from berry set. The sulphur component also corrects mild sulphur deficiency in grape and groundnut.

name: Sansar Green Grapes Fertilizer Fertilizer
description: Grape-specific balanced fertilizer with added calcium and magnesium for bunch weight and berry firmness. Apply 40-50 g around each healthy vine at bud break and again after fruit set, then irrigate. Keeps foliage dark green through the berry filling stage.

name: Green Dews CITRUS PLANT FOOD Fertilizer
description: Chelated micronutrient plant food with zinc, manganese, iron and magnesium, the exact nutrients citrus greening trees are starved of. Dissolve 5 g per litre and foliar spray every 30 days, or apply 100 g per grown tree in the soil twice a year. Restores leaf colour and reduces fruit drop in HLB-affected orchards alongside vector control.

name: SCORE FUNGICIDE
description: Difenoconazole 25% EC systemic fungicide that stops bacterial-spot-associated leaf blights and scab with strong curative action. Use 0.5 ml per litre of water (100 ml per acre) and spray at first symptom, repeating after 10-14 days. Rainfast within two hours and gentle on peach foliage at label dose.

name: Jeevamrut (Plant Growth Tonic)
description: Traditional fermented cow-dung and jaggery tonic teeming with beneficial soil microbes. Dilute 20 ml per litre of water and drench the root zone every 15 days, or add 1 litre per acre to drip irrigation. Keeps healthy peach and stone-fruit trees vigorous while improving soil microbial activity.

name: Systemic Fungicide (Domark) Tetraconazole 3.8% w/w (4% w/v) EW
description: Tetraconazole 3.8% EW systemic fungicide that checks the leaf spotting and defoliation that follow bacterial spot infection. Spray 1 ml per litre of water (250 ml per acre) at 10-day intervals, alternating with a copper bactericide. Micro-emulsion formulation spreads well on waxy capsicum leaves.

name: Casa De Amor Organic Potash Fertilizer
description: Organic potash sourced from sugarcane vinasse that thickens cell walls and improves fruit size and colour. Mix 50 g per plant into the top soil every three weeks during flowering and fruiting. Healthy bell pepper plants fed on it set firmer, better-coloured fruit and resist stress better.

name: Parin Herbal Fungicides (With Turmeric Extract)
description: Herbal fungicide built on turmeric and other plant extracts for early blight, leaf spot and collar rot. Spray 3-5 ml per litre of water every 8-10 days from the first concentric-ring lesion. Zero waiting period makes it ideal for potato and tomato that are harvested continuously.

name: Syngenta Ridomil gold Fungicide
description: Metalaxyl-M 4% plus mancozeb 64% WP, the reference product for late blight of potato and tomato. Apply 2.5 g per litre of water (about 700 g per acre) as soon as blight weather sets in, with a maximum of three sprays per season. The systemic metalaxyl protects new growth while mancozeb guards the existing canopy.

name: Saosis Fertilizer for potato Fertilizer
description: Potato-specific high phosphorus and potash blend that drives tuber bulking and skin finish. Apply 40 kg per acre at earthing-up alongside the basal dose, or 25 g per plant in kitchen gardens. Keeps healthy potato crops firm-tubered and improves storage quality.

name: Karen's Naturals, Organic Just Raspberries
description: Certified organic freeze-dried whole raspberries with nothing added, useful as a value-added reference product for berry growers and FPOs. Each 42 g pack is made from roughly 500 g of fresh healthy fruit. Stocked to show growers the premium that clean, disease-free raspberry produce can fetch.

name: Max Crop Liquid Fertilizer
description: Liquid fertilizer concentrate combining amino acids, seaweed and NPK for quick foliar uptake in pulses and oilseeds. Spray 2.5 ml per litre of water (500 ml per acre) at branching and again at pod formation. Keeps healthy soybean canopies green during pod fill and reduces flower drop.

name: No powdery mildew 1 quart
description: Ready-to-dilute oil and soap formulation that smothers powdery mildew spores on cucurbit foliage without sulphur burn. Mix 30 ml per litre and spray the undersides of leaves in the evening, repeating weekly under humid conditions. Safe right up to harvest on squash, cucumber and melon.

name: Greatindos Premium Quality All in 1 Organic Fungicide
description: Premium botanical fungicide for leaf scorch, leaf spot and blight on soft fruit and vegetables. Dilute 3 ml per litre of water and spray every 10 days, covering the crown and lower leaves where scorch starts. Residue-free, so strawberry picking can continue the same week.

name: SWISS GREEN ORGANIC PLANT GROWTH PROMOTER STRAWBERRY Fertilizer
description: Organic plant growth promoter formulated for strawberry runners, flowering and fruit sizing. Spray 3 ml per litre of water every 15 days from the runner stage through harvest. Keeps healthy strawberry beds throwing uniform, well-coloured berries.

name: CUREAL Best Fungicide & Bactericide
description: Zinc-based systemic fungicide plus bactericide that tackles bacterial spot, canker and blight in one spray. Use 2 ml per litre of water (400 ml per acre) at 8-10 day intervals from the first water-soaked lesion. The chelated zinc also corrects the zinc deficiency common in blighted tomato fields.

name: NATIVO FUNGICIDE
description: Tebuconazole 50% plus trifloxystrobin 25% WG combination that both cures early blight and greens up the crop. Dissolve 0.5 g per litre of water (140 g per acre) and spray at first ring-spot, with a second round after 15 days. Long persistence means fewer sprays per season on tomato and potato.

name: ACROBAT FUNGICIDE
description: Dimethomorph 9% plus mancozeb 60% WP designed specifically for late blight and downy mildew. Spray 3 g per litre of water (about 800 g per acre) the moment cool, humid blight weather begins. Dimethomorph stops spore germination and mycelial growth while mancozeb protects untreated tissue.

name: Virus Special (Set of Immuno 1 ltr + Enviro 1 ltr)
description: Two-part plant-defence set (Immuno plus Enviro) that induces systemic resistance and suppresses leaf mold and viral symptom expression. Spray 2.5 ml of each per litre of water together, every 10 days for three rounds. Best started early, alongside removal of infected leaves and whitefly control.

name: Roko Fungicide
description: Thiophanate methyl 70% WP, a broad spectrum systemic that cures septoria leaf spot and anthracnose from inside the leaf. Use 1 g per litre of water (250-300 g per acre) at 10-12 day intervals. Also effective as a seed and soil drench treatment against damping off.

name: OMITE INSECTICIDE
description: Propargite 57% EC acaricide that knocks down two-spotted spider mites at every mobile stage. Spray 2 ml per litre of water (500 ml per acre), directing the nozzle at the undersides of leaves where webbing appears. One well-timed spray usually breaks the mite cycle; repeat after 15 days if hot dry weather continues.

name: Propi Propineb 70% WP Fungicide for Plants Diesese Control Pesticide
description: Propineb 70% WP contact fungicide for target spot, early blight and downy mildew, with bonus zinc nutrition. Mix 2.5 g per litre of water and spray to full coverage every 10 days during the humid season. An economical protectant to rotate with systemic fungicides and slow resistance.

name: Syngenta Amistor Top Fungicide
description: Azoxystrobin 18.2% plus difenoconazole 11.4% SC that keeps the canopy healthy so virus-stressed plants can outgrow yellow leaf curl damage. Spray 1 ml per litre of water (200 ml per acre) every 12-15 days, combined with whitefly vector control. The greening effect also improves fruit setting under stress.

name: V Bind Viral Disease Special
description: Plant-extract viricide that binds viral coat protein and blocks cell-to-cell movement of mosaic virus. Spray 2 ml per litre of water at 7-day intervals for three rounds starting from the first mottled leaf. Combine with rogueing of infected plants and sticky traps for aphid and whitefly vectors.

name: Tomato Fertilizer Organic, for Home, Balcony, Terrace & Outdoor Gardening
description: Organic tomato feed of vermicompost, bone meal and neem cake with balanced NPK plus calcium against blossom-end rot. Mix 50 g per plant into the top soil at transplanting and repeat every 25 days. Made for home, balcony and terrace tomato growing as well as small market gardens.

name: Urea 46% N (Neem Coated) - 45 kg Bag
description: Neem-coated urea with 46% nitrogen, the primary top-dressing nitrogen source for Indian farms at the government subsidised price. Apply 45-110 kg per acre in 2-3 splits at tillering, active growth and pre-flowering rather than all at once. Do not apply just before heavy rain or on standing water, as nitrogen is lost to leaching and volatilisation.

name: DAP Di-Ammonium Phosphate 18-46-0 - 50 kg Bag
description: Di-ammonium phosphate supplying 18% nitrogen and 46% phosphorus, the standard basal dose at sowing for phosphorus-hungry crops. Drill 40-50 kg per acre with the seed at sowing; it dissolves quickly and feeds early root development. Best suited to wheat, mustard, gram, soybean and potato.

name: MOP Muriate of Potash 0-0-60 - 50 kg Bag
description: Muriate of potash with 60% water-soluble potassium, the cheapest source of K for tuber, fruit and fibre crops. Apply 20-40 kg per acre as a basal dose and top-dress the rest at tuber or boll formation. Improves fruit size, tuber weight, drought tolerance and disease resistance; avoid on chloride-sensitive crops like tobacco.

name: NPK 10-26-26 Complex Fertilizer - 50 kg Bag
description: High phosphorus and potash complex that supports tuber bulking, boll development and fruit set. Broadcast 50 kg per acre as a basal dose before sowing or at earthing-up, then incorporate into moist soil. Well suited to potato, cotton, chilli and grape where potassium demand is heavy.

name: NPK 14-35-14 Complex Fertilizer - 50 kg Bag
description: High-phosphorus complex for strong root establishment and profuse flowering in oilseeds and pulses. Apply 50 kg per acre as a basal dressing at sowing, placed 5 cm below the seed. Particularly effective on groundnut, soybean and cotton in phosphorus-deficient black soils.

name: NPK 17-17-17 Balanced Complex - 50 kg Bag
description: Fully balanced NPK complex where nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium are needed in equal measure. Apply 50 kg per acre split between a basal dose and a top dressing 30-40 days after planting. Suits vegetables, banana, sugarcane and orchard crops in fertigation or broadcast use.

name: NPK 20-20-0-13 Complex with Sulphur - 50 kg Bag
description: Balanced nitrogen and phosphorus complex carrying 13% sulphur, exactly what oilseeds and pulses need for oil synthesis. Drill 50 kg per acre at sowing as the basal dose. Sulphur also improves onion pungency and mustard oil content on light soils.

name: NPK 28-28-0 Complex Fertilizer - 50 kg Bag
description: High-analysis nitrogen and phosphorus complex, a concentrated alternative to DAP plus urea for cereals. Apply 35-45 kg per acre at sowing and again at tillering in wheat, rice and maize. The higher nutrient density means fewer bags to carry and spread per acre.

name: Neem Oil 1500 PPM Azadirachtin 0.15% EC
description: Cold-pressed neem oil standardised to 1500 ppm azadirachtin, acting as an antifeedant, repellent and growth regulator against mites, whitefly, aphids and thrips. Mix 3-5 ml per litre of water with a spreader and spray in the evening every 7-10 days. Also suppresses powdery mildew and is allowed in certified organic production.

name: Trichoderma Viride 1% WP Bio-Fungicide
description: Live antagonistic fungus that colonises the root zone and parasitises soil-borne pathogens causing wilt, root rot, damping off and collar rot. Treat seed at 5-10 g per kg, or mix 2 kg with 100 kg of well-rotted farmyard manure and broadcast over one acre before sowing. Keep away from chemical fungicides for at least 4 days and store in a cool, shaded place.

name: Pseudomonas Fluorescens 1% WP Bio-Bactericide
description: Beneficial rhizobacterium that suppresses bacterial spot, blight and wilt while triggering induced systemic resistance in the crop. Use 10 g per kg for seed treatment, 5 g per litre as a seedling root dip, or 2 kg per acre in farmyard manure as a soil application. Compatible with Trichoderma and organic inputs but not with chemical bactericides.

name: Vermicompost Organic Manure - 25 kg Bag
description: Fully cured earthworm castings with roughly 1.5% N, 1% P and 1.5% K plus humus and beneficial microbes. Apply 800 kg to 2 tonnes per acre before sowing, or 250-500 g per plant around the root zone of vegetables and fruit trees. Improves water holding capacity and soil structure, and lets you cut chemical fertilizer by about 25%.

name: Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate 21% - 5 kg
description: Zinc sulphate heptahydrate with 21% zinc, the fix for the khaira and interveinal chlorosis seen in zinc-deficient rice, wheat and citrus. Apply 10 kg per acre in soil before sowing, or spray 5 g per litre of water with 2.5 g of lime to prevent leaf scorch. Two foliar sprays 15 days apart correct visible deficiency within a fortnight.

name: Boron 20% Di-Sodium Octaborate Tetrahydrate - 1 kg
description: Highly soluble boron source that prevents hollow stem in cauliflower, fruit cracking in tomato and pomegranate, and poor pod filling in groundnut. Spray 1 g per litre of water at flowering and again 15 days later, or apply 2-4 kg per acre in soil. Do not exceed the label dose, as boron turns toxic in a narrow margin above the requirement.

name: Hybrid Tomato F1 Seeds (Determinate, Wilt Tolerant) - 10 g
description: High-yielding F1 tomato hybrid with firm, square-round fruits of 90-100 g and tolerance to bacterial wilt and leaf curl virus. One 10 g pack raises enough seedlings for an acre at 8000-9000 plants; sow in pro-trays and transplant at 25-30 days. First picking begins around 65-70 days after transplanting with 25-30 tonnes per acre potential.

name: Hybrid Maize Seed (Single Cross, Kharif/Rabi) - 4 kg
description: Single-cross maize hybrid with sturdy stalks, good husk cover and field tolerance to turcicum and maydis leaf blight. One 4 kg pack sows an acre at 60 x 20 cm spacing, giving about 27000 plants. Matures in 100-115 days with a yield potential of 30-35 quintals per acre under assured irrigation.

name: Pusa Basmati 1121 Paddy Seed - 10 kg
description: Certified Pusa Basmati 1121 seed, the export-grade long grain variety with an extra-long kernel of 8.4 mm after cooking. Use 10-12 kg per acre for transplanting; it matures in about 140-145 days and yields 20-22 quintals per acre. Treat with Trichoderma or carbendazim before sowing to guard against seed-borne blast and bakanae.

name: HD-2967 Wheat Seed (Certified) - 40 kg Bag
description: Certified HD-2967 seed, the widely grown timely-sown irrigated wheat variety of north India with good yellow and brown rust resistance. Sow 40 kg per acre between the first and third week of November at 22.5 cm row spacing. Matures in about 145 days with a yield potential of 22-24 quintals per acre.

name: Battery Operated Knapsack Sprayer 16 Litre (12V 8Ah)
description: Double-motor 16 litre knapsack sprayer with a 12V 8Ah rechargeable battery giving 6-8 hours of spraying on one charge. Comes with four nozzles including a hollow cone and a flat fan, plus a manual override lever for use when the battery runs down. Covers 2-3 acres per charge and cuts spraying labour compared with a lever-operated pump.

name: Soil pH and NPK Test Kit (50 Tests)
description: Field kit with reagents, a colour comparison chart and test tubes for about 50 soil pH plus nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium readings. Results come in 10 minutes and feed straight into the KrishiDisha crop and fertilizer recommendation tools. Test each plot before every season so lime, gypsum and fertilizer doses are based on real soil data.

name: Yellow and Blue Sticky Traps (Pack of 20, 6x8 inch)
description: UV-stable double-sided glue traps: yellow catches whitefly, aphids and leaf miners while blue catches thrips. Install 8-10 traps per acre just above the canopy and raise them as the crop grows, replacing every 3-4 weeks. Cutting the whitefly population is the single most effective way to slow leaf curl and mosaic virus spread.
